technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early reversal signals (StochRSI cross-up, Williams %R rising) are offset by pervasive bearish structure—price below all major moving averages, negative momentum (MACD, AO, CMF), and bearish trend indicators (PSAR, Hull, Ichimoku)—making this a high-risk bounce attempt rather than a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: DTE shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 43 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent score 11) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is absent and stale (most recent trade 147 days old), limiting conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (383.5) with flat yield curve, FOMC event today, and macro_score of -5 create severely adverse conditions; utilities defensive positioning offers limited offset to systemic stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI (9 & 14) with StochRSI cross-up and contrarian fear-zone sentiment create a technical bounce setup near support (102.13), offering asymmetric risk/reward for a short-term mean reversion trade.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all major MAs, negative MACD/AO/CMF, PSAR/Hull/Ichimoku bearish), zero fundamental conviction, FOMC event today, VIX crisis (383.5), and macro_score -5 create systemic headwinds that overwhelm oversold technicals and make this a high-risk bounce trap rather than a swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold technicals (RSI 9/14) with StochRSI cross-up offer theoretical bounce setup, but FOMC event today combined with VIX crisis (383.5) and macro_score -5 create unacceptable systemic risk that negates mean-reversion opportunity.

decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on high risk; technical bounce signals overwhelmed by macro crisis, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings uncertainty in 43 days
